name: Glow Solar Farm TX-042 (Uvalde County, TX)
description_text: A 4.2 MW community solar farm in Uvalde County, Texas, financed via GLW token delegation under the Glow Protocol's 100-week reward vesting program. 100% of electricity revenue from the farm flows to Glow's shared revenue pool; financers who delegated GLW to this farm earn GLW token rewards over the vesting window, not a direct cash cut of the farm's electricity sales.

yield_profile.yield_calculation_basis: Annualized from 22 weeks of observed GLW reward emissions to this farm's delegators, valued at the GLW/USD spot price on each distribution date, divided by the USD-equivalent value of the delegated GLW at the time of delegation.

verification.verification_notes: Electricity output is verified via satellite and AI imagery analysis under Glow's Proof of Physical Work protocol; resulting GLW reward issuance is executed on-chain and independently queryable by anyone.

exposure.operator_track_record_notes: First farm operated by this entity within the Glow network; no prior Glow farms to reference for this specific operator.
